subject: Recap + Proposal: PoC success criteria, eval mode & ownership
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Malik <sara@minahealth.com>, Tom Boyle <tom@minahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + Proposal: PoC success criteria, eval mode & ownership

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment on the problem space and the three flows you showed. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can lock next steps: 

Scope (proposed):
- 4-week PoC combining an initial offline de-identified evaluation (weeks 1–2) and a live shadow run (weeks 3–4) against a narrow subset of traffic.
- Goal: validate functional accuracy on your labeled set and confirm latency/ops at expected traffic.

Primary success criteria (draft):
- Extraction accuracy (entity-level F1) >= 92% on your holdout.
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for typical request size (token distribution we'll confirm).
- Error rate < 1% (exceptions / failed inference).
- Cost runway estimate: <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll model after we see the sample).
- Security: no PHI left in logs; encrypted in transit and at rest.

Evaluation plan (draft):
- Week 1–2: offline evaluation using de-identified CSV + withheld labeled set you provide. This lets us iterate quickly without connecting to prod traffic.
- Week 3–4: shadowing mode — model receives real requests but responses are not surfaced to users; we measure latency, throughput, and surface edge cases.
- Grading: combine offline accuracy metrics with shadow ops metrics into a single pass/fail rubric (details attached).

Ownership:
- Redwood: Priyom (PoC lead), Ben (infra & deployment), Laura (Customer Success / adoption).
- Mina Health: Tom (technical lead), Sara (product lead).

Next steps we need to move forward:
1) You confirm the acceptability of the proposed hybrid eval approach (offline → shadow) or if you prefer purely offline first.
2) Send the de-identified sample and the labeled holdout (instructions attached) by EOD Tue, Nov 3.
3) Sign the attached PoC SOW (simple 4-week engagement) or confirm any redlines by Nov 5 so we can kick off week of Nov 9.

Attachments: PoC_SOW_v1.pdf, Mina_Data_Sample_Instructions.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bPoC-MinaHealth

If this all looks good I’ll prepare the final rubric and a 30/60/90 checklist for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Priyom

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + Proposal: PoC success criteria, eval mode & ownership

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before we greenlight: 

1) PHI concerns: our security team prefers we do purely offline de-identified evaluation first. Can we run the full offline pass (with your infra in our VPC or via S3 pull) and defer any shadowing until we sign off on privacy controls?

2) Rubric detail: the accuracy metric you propose — is that strict F1 on entities or a blended metric (intent + extraction)? We need to know how you weight precision vs recall because false positives vs false negatives have different downstream impacts for us.

3) Timeline: if we push shadowing later, would you still be able to complete the PoC within 4 weeks or should we plan a 6-week cadence?

If you can send a short decision matrix on offline-only vs hybrid and an explicit rubric weighting, we can review with security and product and confirm by Nov 5.

—Tom
Tom Boyle | Head of Product, Mina Health
tom@minahealth.com | +1 (646) 555-0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Boyle <tom@minahealth.com>, Sara Malik <sara@minahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + Proposal: PoC success criteria, eval mode & ownership

Tom — great questions. Short answers up front, then a suggested decision matrix and rubric so you have concrete language to take to Security/Product.

PHI & data handling:
- We can absolutely start with a fully offline, de-identified workflow. Options: you host the de-identified data in your account and we pull (read-only), or you provide an encrypted S3 link and we run in our dedicated PoC environment with a short-lived key. If you want the tightest controls we can also run the evaluation in your VPC via our private deployment package (requires a short infra setup but avoids traffic egress concerns).

Tradeoffs (offline-only vs hybrid):
- Offline-only (recommended first step): fastest to iterate on model prompts and scoring without any risk to production. Won't measure real-world latency or unseen edge cases in live traffic.
- Hybrid (offline -> shadow): gives both functional accuracy and operational validation: latency, cold-starts, rate-limit interactions. Requires access to a shadow tap of live requests (no user-facing changes).

Suggested decision matrix:
- If Security requires zero PHI exposure at any point: offline-only, 2–3 week cadence, extend PoC to 6 weeks to include a final ops validation under a limited, de-identified shadow feed.
- If PHI can be scoped/filtered and the sample is representative: hybrid (4 weeks) starting with offline (week 1–2) and shadow (week 3–4).

Draft grading rubric (simple, reproducible):
- Accuracy (F1 on entities / composites) — weight 60 points. Pass threshold: weighted F1 >= 0.92 => full points; between 0.88–0.92 => partial points; below 0.88 => fail.
- Latency (p95) — weight 20 points. Full points if p95 < 250ms; partial if 250–350ms.
- Throughput/Scaling (observed errors under expected load) — weight 10 points.
- Operational hygiene (error rates, logging completeness, recoverability) — weight 10 points.

Overall pass: >= 85/100 and no single category graded as a hard fail (security or data leakage).

Impact on timeline:
- Offline-only: estimate 2–3 weeks (data prep + iterations); add 2 weeks for a non-production shadow run if desired.
- Hybrid: target 4 weeks; we keep the same milestones but compress iterations during the shadow period.

Attachments: PoC_Rubric_v1.xlsx (rubric + scoring examples).

Proposed next steps (concrete):
1) Confirm preferred eval mode by EOD Nov 5.
2) If offline-first: you share the de-identified sample + labeling instructions; we start automated runs and return an initial accuracy report within 5 business days.
3) If hybrid: sign SOW by Nov 5 so we can provision shadow tap and infra for Nov 9 kickoff.

If helpful, I can join your security sync on Wed to walk through the VPC/KMS options.

Thanks —
Priyom
